notes_for_editor: Identity rests on NGS PID AF9444, which tnlandforms also gives for Covington Mountain (Sauratown), and on coordinates about 600 ft (180 m) apart; the story says the records most likely describe one site. No source read gives a build date, design, height, staffing, fire history or present condition of the tower. Unverified conflict, not cited: a Facebook group post seen only in search results says the tower was built in 1958 and is 72 ft 9 in tall, and a 2020 Instagram post from an NC fire-tower account calls it a 60 ft Aermotor built by the CCC with a 1989 photo. Neither page could be read by fetch_text (the Instagram text is in the cache only as meta tags), so neither is used; an editor who can open them should settle the date. Do not confuse with Moore's Knob, a separate CCC-built steel tower at Hanging Rock State Park (Wikipedia; getupandgocamping.com). The NGS XX codes refer to the survey marker only. Used four search calls for this tower, above the two-call budget.
